lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let ℓ : ℝ := (4 * (n : ℝ) * s + (s - 1) ^ 2) /
      (8 * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let c : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
      fun O => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j0)
    let ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := (Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))).map c
    let τ : Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    let σ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      (τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ.map (fun y => y.val)
    let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
      ((s + 1) * WithLp.ofLp y j0 - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * WithLp.ofLp y j0) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))⁻¹
    ν = σ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure σ ∧ Integrable f σ ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
          (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ∂γ O)
        ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) =
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (s + 1) ^ n) *
          (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ y, f y ∂σ)
approved_definition_context: The orthogonal group is full real O(n), both determinant signs, with inherited matrix Borel structure. Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts G) is Haar probability normalized on the entire compact group.
EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) has its genuine Euclidean l2 norm and actual volume. WithLp.toLp 2 sends coordinates to that Euclidean vector; WithLp.ofLp returns coordinates. Fin n indices are zero-based.

Measure.toSphere(volume) on Metric.sphere zero one is the actual cone-derived surface measure: on Borel sphere subsets B it equals the real dimension times volume({r*u:0<r<1,u in B}). The scalar inverse of its univ mass is in ENNReal; map Subtype.val includes the sphere in the ambient Euclidean space.

multivariateGaussian zero C is the existing stdGaussian pushforward by the continuous linear map obtained from the positive matrix square root of C; matrix inverse is the existing nonsingular inverse.

All real-coerced dimension arithmetic and n/2 exponents are real; n-1 parity/polynomial exponents are natural subtraction. Integrable means absolute Bochner L1. The ambient quotient uses totalized real division/rpow; no global positivity or continuity is asserted.
